verdict.rationale: Merchant catalogs do reach agent surfaces. Every UCP-enabled storefront serves its catalog at its own /api/ucp/mcp endpoint, and the Global Catalog aggregates listings across Shopify merchants. Live probes confirm both endpoints complete handshakes, and marketing says merchants 'get discovered across AI channels' without lifting a finger. However, the evidence is all agent-side consumption; it never documents a merchant-facing feed or import API for publishing or controlling the catalog. Missing for 10: a documented merchant-side catalog feed/import API, merchant controls over what is published to agent surfaces, and coverage of non-Shopify-native or service catalogs.
